verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ. عَلَى «ٱلسُّوْسَنِّ». لِدَاوُدَ خَلِّصْنِي يَا ٱللهُ، لِأَنَّ ٱلْمِيَاهَ قَدْ دَخَلَتْ إِلَى نَفْسِي.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, [A Psalm] of David. Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto [my] soul.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Lilies.” By David. Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!

verses.ar: غَرِقْتُ فِي حَمْأَةٍ عَمِيقَةٍ، وَلَيْسَ مَقَرٌّ. دَخَلْتُ إِلَى أَعْمَاقِ ٱلْمِيَاهِ، وَٱلسَّيْلُ غَمَرَنِي.
verses.kjv: I sink in deep mire, where [there is] no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
verses.web: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

verses.ar: تَعِبْتُ مِنْ صُرَاخِي. يَبِسَ حَلْقِي. كَلَّتْ عَيْنَايَ مِنِ ٱنْتِظَارِ إِلَهِي.
verses.kjv: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
verses.web: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.

verses.ar: أَكْثَرُ مِنْ شَعْرِ رَأْسِي ٱلَّذِينَ يُبْغِضُونَنِي بِلَا سَبَبٍ. ٱعْتَزَّ مُسْتَهْلِكِيَّ أَعْدَائِي ظُلْمًا. حِينَئِذٍ رَدَدْتُ ٱلَّذِي لَمْ أَخْطَفْهُ.
verses.kjv: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, [being] mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored [that] which I took not away.
verses.web: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.

verses.ar: يَا ٱللهُ أَنْتَ عَرَفْتَ حَمَاقَتِي، وَذُنُوبِي عَنْكَ لَمْ تَخْفَ.
verses.kjv: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.
verses.web: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.

verses.ar: لَا يَخْزَ بِي مُنْتَظِرُوكَ يَا سَيِّدُ رَبَّ ٱلْجُنُودِ. لَا يَخْجَلْ بِي مُلْتَمِسُوكَ يَا إِلَهَ إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.kjv: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.
verses.web: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord Yahweh of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.

verses.ar: لِأَنِّي مِنْ أَجْلِكَ ٱحْتَمَلْتُ ٱلْعَارَ. غَطَّى ٱلْخَجَلُ وَجْهِي.
verses.kjv: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
verses.web: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.

verses.ar: صِرْتُ أَجْنَبِيًّا عِنْدَ إِخْوَتِي، وَغَرِيبًا عِنْدَ بَنِي أُمِّي.
verses.kjv: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother’s children.
verses.web: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ غَيْرَةَ بَيْتِكَ أَكَلَتْنِي، وَتَعْيِيرَاتِ مُعَيِّرِيكَ وَقَعَتْ عَلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
verses.web: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.

verses.ar: وَأَبْكَيْتُ بِصَوْمٍ نَفْسِي، فَصَارَ ذَلِكَ عَارًا عَلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: When I wept, [and chastened] my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
verses.web: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.

verses.ar: جَعَلْتُ لِبَاسِي مِسْحًا، وَصِرْتُ لَهُمْ مَثَلًا.
verses.kjv: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
verses.web: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.

verses.ar: يَتَكَلَّمُ فِيَّ ٱلْجَالِسُونَ فِي ٱلْبَابِ، وَأَغَانِيُّ شَرَّابِي ٱلْمُسْكِرِ.
verses.kjv: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I [was] the song of the drunkards.
verses.web: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنَا فَلَكَ صَلَاتِي يَارَبُّ فِي وَقْتِ رِضًى. يَا ٱللهُ، بِكَثْرَةِ رَحْمَتِكَ ٱسْتَجِبْ لِي، بِحَقِّ خَلَاصِكَ.
verses.kjv: But as for me, my prayer [is] unto thee, O LORD, [in] an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
verses.web: But as for me, my prayer is to you, Yahweh, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.

verses.ar: نَجِّنِي مِنَ ٱلطِّينِ فَلَا أَغْرَقَ. نَجِّنِي مِنْ مُبْغِضِيَّ وَمِنْ أَعْمَاقِ ٱلْمِيَاهِ.
verses.kjv: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
verses.web: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

verses.ar: لَا يَغْمُرَنِّي سَيْلُ ٱلْمِيَاهِ، وَلَا يَبْتَلِعَنِّي ٱلْعُمْقُ، وَلَا تُطْبِقِ ٱلْهَاوِيَةُ عَلَيَّ فَاهَا.
verses.kjv: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
verses.web: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.

verses.ar: ٱسْتَجِبْ لِي يَارَبُّ لِأَنَّ رَحْمَتَكَ صَالِحَةٌ. كَكَثْرَةِ مَرَاحِمِكَ ٱلْتَفِتْ إِلَيَّ.
verses.kjv: Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness [is] good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
verses.web: Answer me, Yahweh, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَحْجُبْ وَجْهَكَ عَنْ عَبْدِكَ، لِأَنَّ لِي ضِيْقًا. ٱسْتَجِبْ لِي سَرِيعًا.
verses.kjv: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
verses.web: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!

verses.ar: ٱقْتَرِبْ إِلَى نَفْسِي. فُكَّهَا. بِسَبَبِ أَعْدَائِي ٱفْدِنِي.
verses.kjv: Draw nigh unto my soul, [and] redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.
verses.web: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.

verses.ar: أَنْتَ عَرَفْتَ عَارِي وَخِزْيِي وَخَجَلِي. قُدَّامَكَ جَمِيعُ مُضَايِقِيَّ.
verses.kjv: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries [are] all before thee.
verses.web: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.

verses.ar: ٱلْعَارُ قَدْ كَسَرَ قَلْبِي فَمَرِضْتُ. ٱنْتَظَرْتُ رِقَّةً فَلَمْ تَكُنْ، وَمُعَزِّينَ فَلَمْ أَجِدْ.
verses.kjv: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked [for some] to take pity, but [there was] none; and for comforters, but I found none.
verses.web: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.

verses.ar: وَيَجْعَلُونَ فِي طَعَامِي عَلْقَمًا، وَفِي عَطَشِي يَسْقُونَنِي خَلًّا.
verses.kjv: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
verses.web: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.

verses.ar: لِتَصِرْ مَائِدَتُهُمْ قُدَّامَهُمْ فَخًّا، وَلِلْآمِنِينَ شَرَكًا.
verses.kjv: Let their table become a snare before them: and [that which should have been] for [their] welfare, [let it become] a trap.
verses.web: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.

verses.ar: لِتُظْلِمْ عُيُونُهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْبَصَرِ، وَقَلْقِلْ مُتُونَهُمْ دَائِمًا.
verses.kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
verses.web: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.

verses.ar: صُبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ سَخَطَكَ، وَلْيُدْرِكْهُمْ حُمُوُّ غَضَبِكَ.
verses.kjv: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
verses.web: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.

verses.ar: لِتَصِرْ دَارُهُمْ خَرَابًا، وَفِي خِيَامِهِمْ لَا يَكُنْ سَاكِنٌ.
verses.kjv: Let their habitation be desolate; [and] let none dwell in their tents.
verses.web: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلَّذِي ضَرَبْتَهُ أَنْتَ هُمْ طَرَدُوهُ، وَبِوَجَعِ ٱلَّذِينَ جَرَحْتَهُمْ يَتَحَدَّثُونَ.
verses.kjv: For they persecute [him] whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.
verses.web: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.

verses.ar: اِجْعَلْ إِثْمًا عَلَى إِثْمِهِمْ، وَلَا يَدْخُلُوا فِي بِرِّكَ.
verses.kjv: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.
verses.web: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.

verses.ar: لِيُمْحَوْا مِنْ سِفْرِ ٱلْأَحْيَاءِ، وَمَعَ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ لَا يُكْتَبُوا.
verses.kjv: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
verses.web: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنَا فَمِسْكِينٌ وَكَئِيبٌ. خَلَاصُكَ يَا ٱللهُ فَلْيُرَفِّعْنِي.
verses.kjv: But I [am] poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
verses.web: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.

verses.ar: أُسَبِّحُ ٱسْمَ ٱللهِ بِتَسْبِيحٍ، وَأُعَظِّمُهُ بِحَمْدٍ.
verses.kjv: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
verses.web: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

verses.ar: فَيُسْتَطَابُ عِنْدَ ٱلرَّبِّ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ثَوْرِ بَقَرٍ ذِي قُرُونٍ وَأَظْلَافٍ.
verses.kjv: [This] also shall please the LORD better than an ox [or] bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
verses.web: It will please Yahweh better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.

verses.ar: يَرَى ذَلِكَ ٱلْوُدَعَاءُ فَيَفْرَحُونَ، وَتَحْيَا قُلُوبُكُمْ يَا طَالِبِي ٱللهِ.
verses.kjv: The humble shall see [this, and] be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.
verses.web: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ سَامِعٌ لِلْمَسَاكِينِ وَلَا يَحْتَقِرُ أَسْرَاهُ.
verses.kjv: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.
verses.web: For Yahweh hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.

verses.ar: تُسَبِّحُهُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ، ٱلْبِحَارُ وَكُلُّ مَا يَدِبُّ فِيهَا.
verses.kjv: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
verses.web: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱللهَ يُخَلِّصُ صِهْيَوْنَ وَيَبْنِي مُدُنَ يَهُوذَا، فَيَسْكُنُونَ هُنَاكَ وَيَرِثُونَهَا.
verses.kjv: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
verses.web: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.

verses.ar: وَنَسْلُ عَبِيدِهِ يَمْلِكُونَهَا، وَمُحِبُّو ٱسْمِهِ يَسْكُنُونَ فِيهَا.
verses.kjv: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
verses.web: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.
